title: Do not give your mouth to the wound
summary: Truth and praise quiet the tongue before harsh words turn into grief. Keep only the speech that can stand at God's Door.
takeaway: Keep only the speech that can stand at God's Door.
lifeApplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.

source.shortMeaning: Truth and praise quiet the tongue before harsh words turn into grief.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next sharp reply, return the mouth to truth and praise so the speech can still stand clean.
